plan.name: Meetily MOSS 持续开发与可验证落地计划 v3.0

accuracy_status: NOT SCORABLE UNTIL HUMAN-APPROVED FULL REFERENCE EXISTS
release_dependency_chain: P2 -> P3 -> P4 -> P5 -> P6 release HEAD
scope: P6 parallel build, package, lifecycle, acceptance and evidence tooling only

items.requirement: All Tauri build workflows build and stage llama-helper and moss-helper before packaging.
items.required_evidence: build-wiring.json with status PASS

items.requirement: Windows x86_64 Vulkan installer, signature, installed application and Authenticode report are hash-bound to one release commit.
items.required_evidence: release-manifest.json roles installer, installer_signature, application and authenticode_report

items.requirement: moss-helper, llama-helper and ffmpeg are present in the installed payload and have recorded byte counts and SHA-256 values.
items.required_evidence: release-manifest.json roles moss_helper, llama_helper and ffmpeg

items.requirement: Database migration source is included in the release inventory; the final evidence manifest is generated afterward so it can hash the release manifest and final audit without a circular hash dependency.
items.required_evidence: release-manifest.json role database_migration, followed by 07-evidence-manifest.json manifest_status PASS

items.requirement: The Q8 model file name, byte count, revision and SHA-256 match the frozen P1 lock.
items.required_evidence: asset-integrity.json model checks all true

items.requirement: The transcribe.cpp 0.2.2 CPU/Vulkan runtime has the exact locked top-level file set and hashes.
items.required_evidence: asset-integrity.json runtime_file_set_matches_lock and runtime_hashes_match_lock

items.requirement: Model, runtime, ggml and miniz license files exist and match their pinned sources.
items.required_evidence: asset-integrity.json license checks and bundled license manifest

items.requirement: MOSS model and runtime deploy under D:\MeetilyData and no identical model/runtime payload appears in the application or installer staging roots.
items.required_evidence: D-drive deployment checks PASS and no application/package hash collision

items.requirement: Fresh install leaves protected recordings, settings and existing model data intact and creates the expected application payload.
items.required_evidence: install transition PASS

items.requirement: Upgrade preserves protected files, JSON values and configured SQLite row sets while allowing additive MOSS tables and keys.
items.required_evidence: upgrade transition PASS with exact/preserve/json_preserve/sqlite_preserve assertions

items.requirement: Uninstall removes the application payload, follows the explicit MOSS-data retention policy, and does not remove Whisper, Parakeet, Qwen, Gemma, recordings, database or templates.
items.required_evidence: uninstall transition PASS and every protected root covered by a strong assertion

items.requirement: Approved version rollback keeps old meetings, edits, templates, settings and existing models readable and unchanged.
items.required_evidence: rollback transition PASS

items.requirement: Real-time bubbles, stop convergence and manual edit persistence pass on the frozen real meeting.
items.required_evidence: live-bubbles, stop-convergence and manual-edit-persistence scenarios PASS

items.requirement: Progress, cancel, candidate review, timestamps and anonymous speakers pass without overwriting active text.
items.required_evidence: moss-progress, moss-cancel and candidate-review scenarios PASS

items.requirement: Positive aliases are corrected, unspoken terms are not inserted, people are bound and segment corrections persist after restart.
items.required_evidence: term/person/restart scenarios PASS

items.requirement: Activation, Qwen 3.5 2B summary, template binding, source traceability and 需检查 conflict handling pass.
items.required_evidence: activate-moss, qwen-2b-summary and needs-review-conflict scenarios PASS

items.requirement: Whisper rollback and MOSS reactivation both preserve data.
items.required_evidence: rollback-to-whisper and reactivate-moss scenarios PASS

items.requirement: The installed release completes the main chain offline, with independent network-blocked checks before and after the scenario.
items.required_evidence: offline-release-chain PASS with network-blocked-before and network-blocked-after

items.requirement: Forced exit, network failure, corrupt model and summary failure do not damage original recording, transcript or manual edits.
items.required_evidence: four negative scenarios PASS plus protected data hashes

items.requirement: moss-helper has no remaining process before Qwen starts.
items.required_evidence: process-release-before-summary scenario PASS and residual count 0

items.requirement: 737.728-second raw MOSS CER is at most 20% and no worse than Whisper on the same scored window.
items.required_evidence: human-approved full reference hash, separate reviewer approval record hash, hash-bound raw MOSS/Whisper transcripts, moss_raw_cer and whisper_same_window_cer

items.requirement: Corrected CER is at most 15%, spoken-term accuracy is at least 95%, and unspoken-term insertions equal 0.
items.required_evidence: human-scored metrics bound to the frozen audio hash

items.requirement: Raw speaker error rates are recorded, corrected scored speaker errors are 0, and timestamps parse 100%, are monotonic and stay in bounds.
items.required_evidence: metrics.json speaker/timestamp fields and human reference hash

items.requirement: 737.728-second RTF is at most 1.0 and 3096.62-second audio reaches the tail within 0.5 seconds.
items.required_evidence: metrics.json business_rtf, long_audio_complete and tail timestamp

items.requirement: P0-P5 normalized stage gates are PASS, every listed evidence hash still matches, and Git ancestry is P2 -> P3 -> P4 -> P5 -> P6 release HEAD.
items.required_evidence: P0=P1=P2=P3=P4=P5=PASS stage gate files

items.requirement: Release manifest, frozen-asset-to-release binding, asset integrity, build wiring, lifecycle, acceptance and human-grounded metrics are all PASS on one clean release commit.
items.required_evidence: final-audit.json p6_status PASS and l2_release_status PASS

items.requirement: The fixed eight evidence files exist and 07-evidence-manifest.json records every evidence file hash.
items.required_evidence: 07-evidence-manifest.json manifest_status PASS
